description: This source file implements functionalities related to TPM (Trusted Platform Module), including an HMAC operation and logging utilities. It defines external C functions for use by other components, manages interaction with TPM resource managers, and maps severity levels to Android logging levels.

methods.name: uint32_t tpm_hmac(void * trm,const uint8_t * data,uint32_t data_len,uint8_t * tag,uint32_t tag_len)
methods.description: Performs HMAC operation using the provided TPM resource manager, checks for errors, and copies the result to the provided buffer.

methods.name: void secure_env_log(const char * file,unsigned int line,int severity,const char * tag,const char * msg)
methods.description: Logs a message with severity mapped from an integer severity level, including file name and line number.

ctags.name: secure_env_log
ctags.pattern: /^void secure_env_log(const char* file, unsigned int line, int severity,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * file,unsigned int line,int severity,const char * tag,const char * msg)

ctags.pattern: /^uint32_t tpm_hmac(void* trm, const uint8_t* data, uint32_t data_len,$/
ctags.signature: (void * trm,const uint8_t * data,uint32_t data_len,uint8_t * tag,uint32_t tag_len)
